name: Paracetamol
description: Analgesic and antipyretic medicine used for fever and mild pain. Check dose interval liver disease and total daily dose

name: Ibuprofen
description: Nonsteroidal anti inflammatory medicine used for fever pain and inflammation. Avoid in renal disease gastric ulcer and some pregnancy stages

name: Amoxicillin
description: Beta lactam antibiotic used for selected bacterial infections only when clinically indicated

name: Oral rehydration salts
description: Rehydration therapy for diarrhea vomiting or dehydration risk
